crossRefs.note: He called Gehazi, and said, “Call this Shunammite!” So he called her. When she had come in to him, he said, “Take up…
Then she went in, fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; then she picked up her son, and went out.
He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.
He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the room into the house, and delivered him to his mother; and Elijah said, “Behold, your son lives.”
translations.bsb: Then Elijah took the child, brought him down from the upper room into the house, and gave him to his mother. “Look, your son is alive,” Elijah declared.
translations.kjv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother: and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
translations.asv: And Elijah took the child, and brought him down out of the chamber into the house, and delivered him unto his mother; and Elijah said, See, thy son liveth.
